workflow_plan.goal: Summarize mean elevation for the census tracts that intersect State College borough.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve State College borough boundary
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain a polygon boundary for State College borough to identify intersecting census tracts.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve the registered polygon boundary dataset representing State College borough. The returned candidate must be suitable as a GeoPackage vector boundary for spatial analysis.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject census tracts to raster CRS
workflow_steps.purpose: Transform the census tract geometries from EPSG:26918 to the raster CRS EPSG:3857 for compatible spatial selection and zonal statistics.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the census tract GeoPackage from its observed EPSG:26918 CRS to EPSG:3857. Preserve the observed GEOID field and full tract geometries.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject borough boundary to raster CRS
workflow_steps.purpose: Transform the retrieved borough boundary to EPSG:3857 so it can be used in a compatible spatial join with the census tracts.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the retrieved borough boundary to EPSG:3857. The source CRS must be read from runtime metadata; do not infer or assign a CRS if it is absent.

workflow_steps.title: Select census tracts intersecting State College borough
workflow_steps.purpose: Identify census tracts that intersect the borough while retaining the complete tract geometries for tract-level elevation summaries.
workflow_steps.instructions: Perform a spatial join between the reprojected census tracts and borough boundary using the intersect predicate. Retain one output feature per census tract and preserve the observed GEOID attribute and full tract geometry. Do not guess or rename fields.

workflow_steps.title: Compute mean elevation by intersecting census tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Calculate the mean elevation from the DEM within each census tract that intersects State College borough.
workflow_steps.instructions: Compute mean zonal elevation statistics using the DEM raster and the selected intersecting census tract polygons. Preserve the tract identifier from the zone layer in the CSV output. Use the full selected tract geometries, not borough-clipped geometries.
